front.title: RTP/SDP Signaling for Opus Multistream Operation

abstract.t: This document specifies RTP/SDP signaling for Opus multistream (multichannel) operation, enabling negotiation of layouts such as 5.1 and 7.1 in real-time communications. It defines SDP format parameters for describing multistream configurations and specifies Offer/Answer procedures for interoperable negotiation of multichannel Opus sessions. This document does not define new Opus codec behavior. Rather, it standardizes SDP signaling for Opus multistream operation while continuing to use the Opus RTP payload format defined in [RFC7587] and the channel mapping semantics defined in [RFC7845]. The signaling procedures specified in this document are intended to provide a standardized alternative to deployment-specific approaches that have historically been referred to as "multiopus".
